title: Term life insurance if anyone depends on your income
summary: Spouse, children, aging parents — anyone whose financial stability depends on your earning continuation.
detailsHtml:
Same logic as W-2, sharper consequences

The contractor's family has no employer life insurance to fall back on. If you have dependents, term life coverage at 10–12x annual income is a baseline. Premiums for healthy 30–40 year-olds run $20–$50/month for a $1M 20-year term policy — among the highest return-on-premium products in personal finance, hopefully unused.
